prompt.en: What is the best single sentence you can write today that separates living things from the flame?

text.en: Living things eat, breathe, grow, move, respond and reproduce. Every one of those is something a flame also does, and a mule fails "reproduce" while a dormant seed fails all of them, so this line does not survive Kabir. It is a list of what living things usually do, not what they are.
